plan.title: Traffic Light Grouping by Price or Rank

steps.note: Open the single-stage auction configuration screen.
Configure the event as a Traffic Light auction so its grouping control is available.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Assert that both grouping conditions are offered and no other grouping option is present.
Set the grouping condition to Price.
Switch the grouping condition to Rank.
Verify that Rank is selected after switching.
